PactVerity (PVTY) connects the Solana token community with a practical mission: making AI-service claims independently checkable. Its Proof Engine and Receipt API beta turn supplied service measurements into portable, recheckable receipts using deterministic checks and SHA-256 integrity commitments.

Originally 50 million PVTY were issued; burns can reduce supply. Provider and verifier staking, slashing, governance and settlement utility remain planned, not deployed. The public tools can be evaluated without purchasing PVTY.

Additional PVTY/SOL liquidity-provider tokens are locked through Streamflow for a 12-month term under a non-cancellable, non-transferable lock. View the public lock records through the LP lock proof link above.
